mechanism.claim: An unusually large completed Asian-session USD/HKD move measures rotation in pressure against the HKD trading band. In a high-variation BTC regime, movement toward HKD weakness is risk-off and maps short BTC, while movement toward HKD strength maps long BTC for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of completed USDHKD 00:00-08:00 UTC log return
mechanism.why_distinct: No prior repository alpha uses USDHKD or a currency-board pressure rotation. HPPRR uses one externally fixed Asian peg-pressure channel, not the six-pair dollar factor, FX volatility sponsorship, EM-currency beta, crypto flow, funding, or a prior diagnostic control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC completed prior-24h realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse weekday 08:05 UTC entries conditioned on USDHKD pressure are absent from Gross9 primitives.

features.fx_session: bars_polygon USDHKD interval=1m rows with 00:00<=UTC time<08:00 on one UTC weekday
features.fx_session_valid: at least 450 distinct minutes, first timestamp no later than 00:05, last timestamp no earlier than 07:55, finite positive OHLC; no imputation
features.peg_pressure_change: log(session_close/session_open); strict nonzero; positive means HKD weakening pressure
features.pressure_magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute peg_pressure_change over at most 90 prior valid sessions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared completed-hour BTC log returns over 24 hours ending at decision)
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 valid decision days, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact weekday D 08:00 UTC after both source paths complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.completed_btc: hash-bound completed-hour BTC source through 2026-08-01 for pre-entry variation only
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent currency-board pressure rotation channel at the Asian-session boundary

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no session, pressure definition, rank, side, hold, clock, volatility, or subset repair.
